**Lower bound.** For any point $P$, the triangle inequality gives $BP \ge BC - CP$, so
$$2BP + 3CP \ge 2BC - 2CP + 3CP = 2BC + CP.$$
Then $AP + CP \ge AC$, so
$$AP + 2BP + 3CP \ge AC + 2BC = 2022 + 2\cdot 2023 = 6068.$$

**Equality.** Taking $P = C$ gives $AC + 2BC + 0 = 6068$, so the bound is attained.

ANSWER: 6068
